rows.grounds: subject; referent depends on preceding context
resultant state following attainment of knowledge
anaphoric to kāṃ vidyāṃ, object of vadasva

items.question: What specific knowledge did she attain that the lord must reveal to the speaker?
premises: Her resultant state followed from attaining that knowledge.
The speaker requests the lord to disclose that knowledge.
items.inference: The lord should identify and explain the knowledge she attained.
uncertainties: The referent of 'sā' depends on the preceding narrative context.
items.plain_english: Having obtained which knowledge did she become so? Tell that to me, O lord.
